items.title: Editing an Astro blog on GitHub Pages, in place
items.summary: An idea, with a rough version in progress: fix your own post on the live page, see the Markdown diff, and let a pull request carry it to the source. Astro makes the way back easier. Nothing is measured.

items.title: Wikipedia, but in the age of AI
items.summary: An idea, not a product: each claim keeps its own sources, people sign what they checked, and machine drafts stay labelled. Nothing is built or measured.

items.title: Office tools where the cloud cannot read your files
items.summary: An idea, not a product: mail, documents and files kept on your own machines, with the cloud holding only encrypted copies. Here is the design and where it gets hard.
